verdict.rationale: A government business-filing portal could plausibly offer a natural-language assistant or chat interface, so this axis applies. The evidence pack contains only robots.txt probes showing bot walls (Akamai 403, Incapsula interstitials). Those concern crawler access, not natural-language operation, and nothing documents any natural-language command capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
